description: List entity types (tables) accessible to the authenticated user (enforcing workspace permissions). Read-only. Omit both `offset` and `limit` to retrieve the full legacy list; provide `offset` and/or `limit` for paginated results. Returns `{ meta: { total, offset, limit, hasMore, returned }, items: [{ id, tableName, displayName, dataSourceType, workspaceId }] }` (or an array in legacy mode). Follow with `get_table` to inspect a table's columns.

limit.description: Page size (optional; defaults to 50 when pagination is enabled, max 500).

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset (optional; defaults to 0 when pagination is enabled).

name: list_tables
